peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (77.7): 4.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 304 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Initial resale-wave effect: 3 of the 4 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Jan 2025–Dec 2025), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 19% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Jan 2025 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). 9 months available from Jan 2026; measurable with data to Dec 2026. Observed: 4.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 370 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 710 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,080 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,310 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,420 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,580 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,630 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,820 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 300 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 422 new sales and 668 resales (1,090 purchases); new sales were 38.7% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 668 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 798 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.3%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
